title: BBC Learning English from the News 2025 — Quiz 16
description: Choose the best answer for each question about vocabulary and usage.

elements.name: q151_under_way
elements.title: “Repairs are under way.” What is the status of the repairs?
choices: They have started and are continuing.
elements.correctAnswer: They have started and are continuing.

elements.name: q152_dip
elements.title: We went for a quick ___ in the pool before setting off for lunch.

elements.name: q153_flock
elements.title: Visitors tend to ___ to the gardens when the cherry trees bloom, arriving in large crowds.

elements.name: q154_contain
elements.title: Crews worked to ___ the leak and stop it spreading to nearby pipes.

elements.name: q155_provocation
elements.title: His taunt was a deliberate ___ intended to make the other player react angrily.

elements.name: q156_deception
elements.title: Selling a copy as an original is an act of ___ because it tricks the buyer.

elements.name: q157_come_into_force
elements.title: Which word completes the phrase “come into ___”, meaning that a new rule starts to apply?

elements.name: q158_push_back
elements.title: Which preposition fits “The committee pushed back ___ the proposal by refusing to approve it”?

elements.name: q159_debunk
elements.title: Which form fits “The research team has ___ several myths about sleep”?

elements.name: q160_takeaway
elements.title: Which word fits “What was your main takeaway ___ the meeting”?
